versions.changelog: Correct the licence declarations to Apache-2.0, matching the LICENSE file the project has always carried. No functional change.

First release. Extracts PDF, EPUB, DOCX, RTF, ODT, PPTX, XLSX, CSV, HTML and plain text; routes PDFs per page so multi-column reading order and borderless tables both survive; reports pages that cannot be read as text so they can be read as images instead.
